system.name: LoRA-Pre
system.one_liner: A low-rank optimizer for LLM pre-training that views momentum EMA as an online linear regressor and stores momentum as two low-rank factors with closed-form updates.

content.variant_note: an equivalence between the EMA rule and a least-squares loss, then a mirrored before/after pair across a big 'Low-Rank Compression' arrow
content.argues: The EMA momentum update is the same as training a linear regressor by online gradient descent, so the momentum matrix can be stored as two low-rank factors with closed-form updates.
content.subject: The momentum matrix m as an online linear learner, and its replacement by two low-rank factors m_B and m_A with their loss and update rules.

elements.name: Your Momentum is a Secret Online Linear Learner!
elements.drawn_as: bold title text at the top left inside the dashed frame

elements.name: m' ← β1·m + (1−β1)·g
elements.drawn_as: formula text at the top of the left half

elements.name: Equivalent Form
elements.role: states that the EMA update and the loss below it are the same update
elements.drawn_as: light-blue double-headed vertical block arrow with a bold label beside it

elements.name: L(m; g_t) = ½‖m − g_t‖²_F
elements.role: least-squares loss of a linear regressor on the current gradient
elements.drawn_as: formula text with a short up arrow from the matrix box

elements.name: m
elements.role: the momentum matrix, i.e. the online learner's state
elements.drawn_as: peach square box on the gradient stream

elements.name: g_{t+1}, g_t, g_{t−1} … g_1
elements.role: gradients arriving online; the current g_t is bold black, the others grey
elements.drawn_as: dash-dot arrow running through the matrix (drawn in both halves)

elements.name: Online Gradient Flow update: m' ← m − (1−β1)·∂L/∂m
elements.role: one gradient step on the loss that reproduces the EMA update
elements.drawn_as: bold lead-in 'update:' plus formula under the left half

elements.name: Low-Rank Compression
elements.role: replaces the full momentum matrix by a pair of low-rank factors
elements.drawn_as: large mid-blue right-pointing block arrow in the centre with a bold label

elements.name: L(m_B, m_A; g_t) = ½‖m_B m_A − g_t‖²_F
elements.role: loss on the product of the two factors
elements.drawn_as: formula text above the factors with a short up arrow

elements.name: m_B
elements.drawn_as: peach trapezoid, wide at the top, narrow end pointing down

elements.name: m_A
elements.drawn_as: light-blue trapezoid, narrow end touching m_B, wide at the bottom

elements.name: Online Gradient Flow update: m'_B and m'_A
elements.role: update of each factor with an inverse second-derivative term times the first derivative; the caption says closed form, no backpropagation (Theorem 3.1)
elements.drawn_as: two stacked formula lines under a bold 'update:' lead-in

lessons.what_to_learn: Show an equivalence and its compressed form as a mirrored pair: identical rows (loss, data stream with the object, update rule) on both sides of one big block arrow, so the only differences the eye finds are the contribution (one matrix box becomes two trapezoids, new update rules).
lessons.suits: Theory-heavy methods where a derivation step such as an equivalence, a factorisation or a compression can be drawn as before and after of one object with its formulas.

evidence: the exponential moving average (EMA) update for optimizer momentum is mathematically equivalent to training a linear regressor
we propose compressing the optimizer states (i.e., the momenta) using low-rank matrices to reduce the memory footprint
the closed-form update rules for these matrices without requiring backpropagation are given by Theorem 3.1

summary: LoRA-Pre is a memory-saving optimizer for pre-training language models. The figure is one beige dashed frame headed by the claim 'Your Momentum is a Secret Online Linear Learner!'. The left half writes the EMA momentum update, joins it by a light-blue double-headed 'Equivalent Form' arrow to a least-squares loss on the momentum matrix, and shows the matrix as a peach box on a dash-dot stream of gradients with the online gradient-flow update underneath. A large blue 'Low-Rank Compression' arrow leads to a mirrored right half where the matrix becomes two trapezoids m_B and m_A, a loss on their product and closed-form update rules for each factor.
summary_zh: LoRA-Pre 把动量的指数滑动平均看作在线线性回归，再把动量矩阵压缩成两个低秩因子。图是一个米色虚线框：左半是 EMA 公式、最小二乘损失和梯度流上的矩阵 m，中间是大箭头“低秩压缩”，右半对称地换成 m_B、m_A 及其闭式更新公式。
notes: No body paragraph mentions the figure; roles come from the caption, abstract and the figure itself. Pre-screen kinds kept. The update formula is transcribed as drawn (inverse second derivative times first derivative); the paper text provided does not describe it further.
